definitions: A technique in deep learning that produces a localization map, highlighting the important regions in an image for predicting a certain class.
A method used to visualize the discriminative regions of an image that are used by a convolutional neural network to make a specific prediction.
examples: Researchers used Class Activation Mapping to understand model decisions.
The paper introduced a novel application of Class Activation Mapping.
Class Activation Mapping revealed the critical features.
